#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Battle (part 4)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs battle screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Battle
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Main Phase
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def start_phase4
    # Shift to phase 4
    @phase = 4
    # Turn count
    $game_temp.battle_turn += 1
    # Search all battle event pages
    for index in 0...$data_troops[@troop_id].pages.size
      # Get event page
      page = $data_troops[@troop_id].pages[index]
      # If this page span is [turn]
      if page.span == 1
        # Clear action completed flags
        $game_temp.battle_event_flags[index] = false
      end
    end
    # Set actor as unselectable
    @actor_index = -1
    @active_battler = nil
    # Enable party command window
    @party_command_window.active = false
    @party_command_window.visible = false
    # Disable actor command window
    @actor_command_window.active = false
    @actor_command_window.visible = false
    # Set main phase flag
    $game_temp.battle_main_phase = true
    # Make enemy action
    for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
      enemy.make_action
    end
    # Make action orders
    make_action_orders
    # Shift to step 1
    @phase4_step = 1
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Action Orders
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_action_orders
    # Initialize @action_battlers array
    @action_battlers = []
    # Add enemy to @action_battlers array
    for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
      @action_battlers.push(enemy)
    end
    # Add actor to @action_battlers array
    for actor in $game_party.actors
      @action_battlers.push(actor)
    end
    # Decide action speed for all
    for battler in @action_battlers
      battler.make_action_speed
    end
    # Line up action speed in order from greatest to least
    @action_battlers.sort! {|a,b|
      b.current_action.speed - a.current_action.speed }
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4
    case @phase4_step
    when 1
      update_phase4_step1
    when 2
      update_phase4_step2
    when 3
      update_phase4_step3
    when 4
      update_phase4_step4
    when 5
      update_phase4_step5
    when 6
      update_phase4_step6
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 1 : action preparation)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step1
    # Hide help window
    @help_window.visible = false
    # Determine win/loss
    if judge
      # If won, or if lost : end method
      return
    end
    # If an action forcing battler doesn't exist
    if $game_temp.forcing_battler == nil
      # Set up battle event
      setup_battle_event
      # If battle event is running
      if $game_system.battle_interpreter.running?
        return
      end
    end
    # If an action forcing battler exists
    if $game_temp.forcing_battler != nil
      # Add to head, or move
      @action_battlers.delete($game_temp.forcing_battler)
      @action_battlers.unshift($game_temp.forcing_battler)
    end
    # If no actionless battlers exist (all have performed an action)
    if @action_battlers.size == 0
      # Start party command phase
      start_phase2
      return
    end
    # Initialize animation ID and common event ID
    @animation1_id = 0
    @animation2_id = 0
    @common_event_id = 0
    # Shift from head of actionless battlers
    @active_battler = @action_battlers.shift
    # If already removed from battle
    if @active_battler.index == nil
      return
    end
    # Slip damage
    if @active_battler.hp > 0 and @active_battler.slip_damage?
      @active_battler.slip_damage_effect
      @active_battler.damage_pop = true
    end
    # Natural removal of states
    @active_battler.remove_states_auto
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Shift to step 2
    @phase4_step = 2
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 2 : start action)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step2
    # If not a forcing action
    unless @active_battler.current_action.forcing
      # If restriction is [normal attack enemy] or [normal attack ally]
      if @active_battler.restriction == 2 or @active_battler.restriction == 3
        # Set attack as an action
        @active_battler.current_action.kind = 0
        @active_battler.current_action.basic = 0
      end
      # If restriction is [cannot perform action]
      if @active_battler.restriction == 4
        # Clear battler being forced into action
        $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
        # Shift to step 1
        @phase4_step = 1
        return
      end
    end
    # Clear target battlers
    @target_battlers = []
    # Branch according to each action
    case @active_battler.current_action.kind
    when 0  # basic
      make_basic_action_result
    when 1  # skill
      make_skill_action_result
    when 2  # item
      make_item_action_result
    end
    # Shift to step 3
    if @phase4_step == 2
      @phase4_step = 3
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Basic Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_basic_action_result
    # If attack
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 0
      # Set anaimation ID
      @animation1_id = @active_battler.animation1_id
      @animation2_id = @active_battler.animation2_id
      # If action battler is enemy
      if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
        if @active_battler.restriction == 3
          target = $game_troop.random_target_enemy
        elsif @active_battler.restriction == 2
          target = $game_party.random_target_actor
        else
          index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
          target = $game_party.smooth_target_actor(index)
        end
      end
      # If action battler is actor
      if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Actor)
        if @active_battler.restriction == 3
          target = $game_party.random_target_actor
        elsif @active_battler.restriction == 2
          target = $game_troop.random_target_enemy
        else
          index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
          target = $game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index)
        end
      end
      # Set array of targeted battlers
      @target_battlers = [target]
      # Apply normal attack results
      for target in @target_battlers
        target.attack_effect(@active_battler)
      end
      return
    end
    # If guard
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 1
      # Display "Guard" in help window
      @help_window.set_text($data_system.words.guard, 1)
      return
    end
    # If escape
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy) and
       @active_battler.current_action.basic == 2
      # Display "Escape" in help window
      @help_window.set_text("Apartarse", 1)
      # Escape
      @active_battler.escape
      return
    end
    # If doing nothing
    if @active_battler.current_action.basic == 3
      # Clear battler being forced into action
      $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
      # Shift to step 1
      @phase4_step = 1
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Set Targeted Battler for Skill or Item
  #     scope : effect scope for skill or item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def set_target_battlers(scope)
    # If battler performing action is enemy
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
      # Branch by effect scope
      case scope
      when 1  # single enemy
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_party.smooth_target_actor(index))
      when 2  # all enemies
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 3  # single ally
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index))
      when 4  # all allies
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 5  # single ally (HP 0) 
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        enemy = $game_troop.enemies[index]
        if enemy != nil and enemy.hp0?
          @target_battlers.push(enemy)
        end
      when 6  # all allies (HP 0) 
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy != nil and enemy.hp0?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 7  # user
        @target_battlers.push(@active_battler)
      end
    end
    # If battler performing action is actor
    if @active_battler.is_a?(Game_Actor)
      # Branch by effect scope
      case scope
      when 1  # single enemy
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_troop.smooth_target_enemy(index))
      when 2  # all enemies
        for enemy in $game_troop.enemies
          if enemy.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(enemy)
          end
        end
      when 3  # single ally
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        @target_battlers.push($game_party.smooth_target_actor(index))
      when 4  # all allies
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor.exist?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 5  # single ally (HP 0) 
        index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
        actor = $game_party.actors[index]
        if actor != nil and actor.hp0?
          @target_battlers.push(actor)
        end
      when 6  # all allies (HP 0) 
        for actor in $game_party.actors
          if actor != nil and actor.hp0?
            @target_battlers.push(actor)
          end
        end
      when 7  # user
        @target_battlers.push(@active_battler)
      end
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Skill Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_skill_action_result
    # Get skill
    @skill = $data_skills[@active_battler.current_action.skill_id]
    # If not a forcing action
    unless @active_battler.current_action.forcing
      # If unable to use due to SP running out
      unless @active_battler.skill_can_use?(@skill.id)
        # Clear battler being forced into action
        $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
        # Shift to step 1
        @phase4_step = 1
        return
      end
    end
    # Use up SP
    @active_battler.sp -= @skill.sp_cost
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Show skill name on help window
    @help_window.set_text(@skill.name, 1)
    # Set animation ID
    @animation1_id = @skill.animation1_id
    @animation2_id = @skill.animation2_id
    # Set command event ID
    @common_event_id = @skill.common_event_id
    # Set target battlers
    set_target_battlers(@skill.scope)
    # Apply skill effect
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.skill_effect(@active_battler, @skill)
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Make Item Action Results
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def make_item_action_result
    # Get item
    @item = $data_items[@active_battler.current_action.item_id]
    # If unable to use due to items running out
    unless $game_party.item_can_use?(@item.id)
      # Shift to step 1
      @phase4_step = 1
      return
    end
    # If consumable
    if @item.consumable
      # Decrease used item by 1
      $game_party.lose_item(@item.id, 1)
    end
    # Display item name on help window
    @help_window.set_text(@item.name, 1)
    # Set animation ID
    @animation1_id = @item.animation1_id
    @animation2_id = @item.animation2_id
    # Set common event ID
    @common_event_id = @item.common_event_id
    # Decide on target
    index = @active_battler.current_action.target_index
    target = $game_party.smooth_target_actor(index)
    # Set targeted battlers
    set_target_battlers(@item.scope)
    # Apply item effect
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.item_effect(@item)
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 3 : animation for action performer)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step3
    # Animation for action performer (if ID is 0, then white flash)
    if @animation1_id == 0
      @active_battler.white_flash = true
    else
      @active_battler.animation_id = @animation1_id
      @active_battler.animation_hit = true
    end
    # Shift to step 4
    @phase4_step = 4
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 4 : animation for target)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step4
    # Animation for target
    for target in @target_battlers
      target.animation_id = @animation2_id
      target.animation_hit = (target.damage != "Miss")
    end
    # Animation has at least 8 frames, regardless of its length
    @wait_count = 8
    # Shift to step 5
    @phase4_step = 5
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 5 : damage display)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step5
    # Hide help window
    @help_window.visible = false
    # Refresh status window
    @status_window.refresh
    # Display damage
    for target in @target_battlers
      if target.damage != nil
        target.damage_pop = true
      end
    end
    # Shift to step 6
    @phase4_step = 6
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (main phase step 6 : refresh)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_phase4_step6
    # Clear battler being forced into action
    $game_temp.forcing_battler = nil
    # If common event ID is valid
    if @common_event_id > 0
      # Set up event
      common_event = $data_common_events[@common_event_id]
      $game_system.battle_interpreter.setup(common_event.list, 0)
    end
    # Shift to step 1
    @phase4_step = 1
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Name
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs name input screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Name
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Get actor
    @actor = $game_actors[$game_temp.name_actor_id]
    # Make windows
    @edit_window = Window_NameEdit.new(@actor, $game_temp.name_max_char)
    @input_window = Window_NameInput.new
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of windows
    @edit_window.dispose
    @input_window.dispose
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # Update windows
    @edit_window.update
    @input_window.update
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.repeat?(Input::B)
      # If cursor position is at 0
      if @edit_window.index == 0
        return
      end
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Delete text
      @edit_window.back
      return
    end
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # If cursor position is at [OK]
      if @input_window.character == nil
        # If name is empty
        if @edit_window.name == ""
          # Return to default name
          @edit_window.restore_default
          # If name is empty
          if @edit_window.name == ""
            # Play buzzer SE
            $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
            return
          end
          # Play decision SE
          $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
          return
        end
        # Change actor name
        @actor.name = @edit_window.name
        # Play decision SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        # Switch to map screen
        $scene = Scene_Map.new
        return
      end
      # If cursor position is at maximum
      if @edit_window.index == $game_temp.name_max_char
        # Play buzzer SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
        return
      end
      # If text character is empty
      if @input_window.character == ""
        # Play buzzer SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.buzzer_se)
        return
      end
      # Play decision SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
      # Add text character
      @edit_window.add(@input_window.character)
      return
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Gameover
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs game over screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Gameover
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Make game over graphic
    @sprite = Sprite.new
    @sprite.bitmap = RPG::Cache.gameover($data_system.gameover_name)
    # Stop BGM and BGS
    $game_system.bgm_play(nil)
    $game_system.bgs_play(nil)
    # Play game over ME
    $game_system.me_play($data_system.gameover_me)
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition(120)
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of game over graphic
    @sprite.bitmap.dispose
    @sprite.dispose
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition(40)
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # If battle test
    if $BTEST
      $scene = nil
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # Switch to title screen
      $scene = Scene_Title.new
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Debug
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class performs debug screen processing.
#==============================================================================

class Scene_Debug
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Main Processing
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def main
    # Make windows
    @left_window = Window_DebugLeft.new
    @right_window = Window_DebugRight.new
    @help_window = Window_Base.new(192, 352, 448, 128)
    @help_window.contents = Bitmap.new(406, 96)
    # Restore previously selected item
    @left_window.top_row = $game_temp.debug_top_row
    @left_window.index = $game_temp.debug_index
    @right_window.mode = @left_window.mode
    @right_window.top_id = @left_window.top_id
    # Execute transition
    Graphics.transition
    # Main loop
    loop do
      # Update game screen
      Graphics.update
      # Update input information
      Input.update
      # Frame update
      update
      # Abort loop if screen is changed
      if $scene != self
        break
      end
    end
    # Refresh map
    $game_map.refresh
    # Prepare for transition
    Graphics.freeze
    # Dispose of windows
    @left_window.dispose
    @right_window.dispose
    @help_window.dispose
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update
    # Update windows
    @right_window.mode = @left_window.mode
    @right_window.top_id = @left_window.top_id
    @left_window.update
    @right_window.update
    # Memorize selected item
    $game_temp.debug_top_row = @left_window.top_row
    $game_temp.debug_index = @left_window.index
    # If left window is active: call update_left
    if @left_window.active
      update_left
      return
    end
    # If right window is active: call update_right
    if @right_window.active
      update_right
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (when left window is active)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_left
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Switch to map screen
      $scene = Scene_Map.new
      return
    end
    # If C button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
      # Play decision SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
      # Display help
      if @left_window.mode == 0
        text1 = "C (Enter) : ON / OFF"
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 0, 406, 32, text1)
      else
        text1 = "Left : -1   Right : +1"
        text2 = "L (Pageup) : -10"
        text3 = "R (Pagedown) : +10"
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 0, 406, 32, text1)
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 32, 406, 32, text2)
        @help_window.contents.draw_text(4, 64, 406, 32, text3)
      end
      # Activate right window
      @left_window.active = false
      @right_window.active = true
      @right_window.index = 0
      return
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update (when right window is active)
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_right
    # If B button was pressed
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      # Play cancel SE
      $game_system.se_play($data_system.cancel_se)
      # Activate left window
      @left_window.active = true
      @right_window.active = false
      @right_window.index = -1
      # Erase help
      @help_window.contents.clear
      return
    end
    # Get selected switch / variable ID
    current_id = @right_window.top_id + @right_window.index
    # If switch
    if @right_window.mode == 0
      # If C button was pressed
      if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        # Play decision SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.decision_se)
        # Reverse ON / OFF
        $game_switches[current_id] = (not $game_switches[current_id])
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
    end
    # If variable
    if @right_window.mode == 1
      # If right button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Increase variables by 1
        $game_variables[current_id] += 1
        # Maximum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] > 99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = 99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If left button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Decrease variables by 1
        $game_variables[current_id] -= 1
        # Minimum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] < -99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = -99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If R button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::R)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Increase variables by 10
        $game_variables[current_id] += 10
        # Maximum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] > 99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = 99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
      # If L button was pressed
      if Input.repeat?(Input::L)
        # Play cursor SE
        $game_system.se_play($data_system.cursor_se)
        # Decrease variables by 10
        $game_variables[current_id] -= 10
        # Minimum limit check
        if $game_variables[current_id] < -99999999
          $game_variables[current_id] = -99999999
        end
        @right_window.refresh
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

# ** Vacas - Nucleo

module Vacas
  # --- Variables ---
  VAR_VENENO     = 1   # 0..100
  VAR_ETAPA      = 2
  VAR_CANAL      = 3
  VAR_VECES_TELE = 4
  VAR_AUX        = 5
  # --- Interruptores ---
  SW_HUD_OCULTO  = 15
  SW_SIN_EFECTOS = 16
  # --- Acto II ---
  SW_ACTO2       = 22
  SW_MATADERO    = 23
  SW_FICHADO     = 24
  SW_MONO        = 25
  SW_PATRULLA_CAM = 26
  SW_NOCHE2      = 27
  SW_SUELDO_DADO = 28
  SW_PATRULLA_OFI = 29
  SW_ESCONDIDO2  = 30
  SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS = 31
  SW_PIEZA       = 40
  SW_TURNO3      = 43
  VAR_TURNO      = 7
  VAR_FASE       = 8
  VAR_SUELDO_HOY = 9
  VAR_SUELDO_TOTAL = 10
  VAR_GUERNSEY   = 11
  VAR_RESULTADO  = 12
  VAR_PIEZAS     = 13
  VAR_PIEZA      = 14
  VAR_HUELLA     = 15
  VENENO_MAX     = 100
  # --- Graficos propios ---
  WINDOWSKIN = "vacas_ventana"
  TITULO     = "vacas_titulo"
  GAMEOVER   = "vacas_gameover"
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ajusta datos de System.rxdata que el MCP no puede editar
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def self.ajustar_sistema
    return if $data_system == nil
    $data_system.party_members = [1]
    $data_system.title_name    = TITULO
    $data_system.gameover_name = GAMEOVER
    $data_system.windowskin_name = WINDOWSKIN
    $data_system.title_bgm = RPG::AudioFile.new("058-Slow01", 80, 80)
    $data_system.gameover_me = RPG::AudioFile.new("016-Shock01", 90, 70)
    w = $data_system.words
    w.gold = "monedas"
    w.item = "Objetos"
    w.hp = "Salud"
    w.sp = "Aliento"
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def self.veneno
    return 0 if $game_variables == nil
    return $game_variables[VAR_VENENO]
  end
  # La huella (variable 15) es un suelo: lo que has hecho ya no baja.
  def self.huella
    return 0 if $game_variables == nil
    return $game_variables[VAR_HUELLA]
  end
  def self.veneno=(v)
    v = 0 if v < 0
    v = huella if v < huella
    v = VENENO_MAX if v > VENENO_MAX
    $game_variables[VAR_VENENO] = v
    $game_map.need_refresh = true if $game_map != nil
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Interpreter - comandos para usar en "Llamar script"
#   Todos devuelven true para que el interprete no repita el comando.
#==============================================================================
class Interpreter
  def subir_veneno(n)
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno + n
    fuerza = 40 + n * 6
    fuerza = 200 if fuerza > 200
    $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(150, 0, 0, fuerza), 12)
    $game_screen.start_shake(2 + n / 10, 8, 10 + n)
    $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("140-Darkness03", 70, 60))
    $vacas_hud_pulso = 40
    return true
  end
  def bajar_veneno(n)
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno - n
    $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(200, 220, 255, 50), 20)
    $vacas_hud_pulso = 20
    return true
  end
  def veneno_al_maximo?
    return Vacas.veneno >= Vacas::VENENO_MAX
  end
  # Sube el veneno sin pasar de un tope (para escenas que no deben matar)
  def subir_veneno_tope(n, tope)
    n = tope - Vacas.veneno if Vacas.veneno + n > tope
    n = 0 if n < 0
    subir_veneno(n)
    return true
  end
  # Marca permanente: el veneno ya no baja de aqui
  def huella(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_HUELLA] = n if $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_HUELLA] < n
    Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno
    return true
  end
  def poner_mono(si)
    nombre = si ? "vacas_steven_mono" : "vacas_steven"
    $game_actors[1].set_graphic(nombre, 0, "", 0)
    $game_player.refresh
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_MONO] = si
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Paga el sueldo: monedas visibles y variables de sueldo
  def cobrar(n)
    $game_party.gain_gold(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_HOY] += n
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_TOTAL] += n
    return true
  end
  # Madre se lleva el sueldo. Si guardar es true, Steven esconde una moneda.
  def entregar_sueldo(guardar)
    g = $game_party.gold
    g -= 1 if guardar and g > 0
    $game_party.lose_gold(g)
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_SUELDO_DADO] = true
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Prepara el siguiente turno (al dormir)
  def nuevo_turno
    for i in [Vacas::SW_FICHADO, Vacas::SW_MONO, Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_CAM, Vacas::SW_NOCHE2,
              Vacas::SW_SUELDO_DADO, Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_OFI, Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2,
              Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS, Vacas::SW_PIEZA]
      $game_switches[i] = false
    end
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO] += 1
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_FASE] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_SUELDO_HOY] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_PIEZAS] = 0
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_PIEZA] = 0
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_MATADERO] = true
    $game_switches[Vacas::SW_TURNO3] = ($game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO] == 3)
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  # Perro: una caricia que cura, una vez por noche
  def perro_esta_noche?
    return $game_variables[17] < $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO]
  end
  def perro_hecho
    $game_variables[17] = $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_TURNO]
    return true
  end
  def fase(n)
    $game_variables[Vacas::VAR_FASE] = n
    $game_map.need_refresh = true
    return true
  end
  def fin_del_acto
    $scene = Scene_FinActo.new(1)
    return true
  end
  def fin_del_acto2
    $scene = Scene_FinActo.new(2)
    return true
  end
end

module Vacas

  def self.empezar_acto2
    $game_switches[SW_HUD_OCULTO] = false

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Veneno (cordura)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Indicador discreto en pantalla y efectos (tono, temblor, destellos)
#  que crecen con la variable 1 "Veneno" (0..100).
#==============================================================================

$vacas_hud_pulso = 0

class Sprite_Veneno < Sprite
  ANCHO = 96
  def initialize
    super(nil)
    self.bitmap = Bitmap.new(ANCHO + 8, 22)
    self.x = 14
    self.y = 480 - 34
    self.z = 4000
    @valor = -1
    @contador = 0
    refrescar
  end
  def dispose
    self.bitmap.dispose if self.bitmap != nil
    super
  end
  def refrescar
    v = Vacas.veneno
    @valor = v
    b = self.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.font.size = 13
    b.font.color = Color.new(190, 170, 140, 255)
    b.draw_text(0, 0, ANCHO, 12, "veneno")
    # marco
    b.fill_rect(0, 14, ANCHO, 6, Color.new(0, 0, 0, 200))
    b.fill_rect(1, 15, ANCHO - 2, 4, Color.new(40, 32, 26, 220))
    largo = (ANCHO - 2) * v / Vacas::VENENO_MAX
    if largo > 0
      r = 150 + v
      r = 255 if r > 255
      g = 120 - v
      g = 10 if g < 10
      b.fill_rect(1, 15, largo, 4, Color.new(r, g, 20, 255))
    end
  end
  def update
    super
    refrescar if @valor != Vacas.veneno
    oculto = ($game_switches != nil and $game_switches[Vacas::SW_HUD_OCULTO])
    @contador += 1
    base = 110 + Vacas.veneno
    if Vacas.veneno >= 50
      # latido: mas rapido cuanto mas veneno
      periodo = 70 - Vacas.veneno / 2
      periodo = 20 if periodo < 20
      base += 50 if (@contador % periodo) < 6
    end
    if $vacas_hud_pulso > 0
      $vacas_hud_pulso -= 1
      base = 255 if ($vacas_hud_pulso / 4) % 2 == 0
    end
    base = 255 if base > 255
    if oculto
      self.opacity = 0
    else
      self.opacity = base
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Spriteset_Map - tono extra y efectos aleatorios segun el veneno
#==============================================================================
class Spriteset_Map
  alias vacas_ssm_initialize initialize
  def initialize
    @vacas_hud = Sprite_Veneno.new
    vacas_ssm_initialize
  end
  alias vacas_ssm_dispose dispose
  def dispose
    @vacas_hud.dispose
    vacas_ssm_dispose
  end
  alias vacas_ssm_update update
  def update
    vacas_ssm_update
    return if @vacas_hud == nil
    @vacas_hud.update
    v = Vacas.veneno
    t = $game_screen.tone
    # el veneno amarillea, apaga el azul y quita color
    rr = t.red + v * 0.30
    gg = t.green - v * 0.15
    bb = t.blue - v * 0.45
    gr = t.gray + v * 1.4
    gr = 255 if gr > 255
    @viewport1.tone = Tone.new(rr, gg, bb, gr)
    vacas_efectos(v)
  end
  def vacas_efectos(v)
    return if $game_switches[Vacas::SW_SIN_EFECTOS]
    return if $game_temp.message_window_showing
    if v >= 35 and rand(900 - v * 6) == 0
      $game_screen.start_shake(1 + v / 35, 5, 6 + v / 10)
    end
    if v >= 55 and rand(1100 - v * 8) == 0
      $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 30 + v), 4 + v / 12)
    end
    if v >= 75 and rand(1600 - v * 10) == 0
      $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("040-Knock01", 60, 70))
      $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 160), 10)
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Menu de terror
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Menu reducido: Objetos / Guardar (solo con la tele) / Salir, con una
#  lista de tareas pendientes. Sin estado, equipo ni habilidades.
#==============================================================================

module Vacas
  # Devuelve [[texto, hecho], ...] segun los interruptores de la historia
  def self.tareas
    s = $game_switches
    lista = []
    return tareas_acto2 if s[22]
    if s[14]
      lista.push(["Ya tienes trabajo.", true])
    elsif s[13]
      lista.push(["Bajar a la calle: el camión del matadero.", false])
    elsif s[10]
      lista.push(["Esconderte. Ya viene.", false])
    elsif s[9]
      lista.push(["Ir a dormir.", false])
    elsif s[2]
      lista.push(["Dar de comer a Perro.", s[3]])
      lista.push(["Llevarle el jarabe a madre.", s[4]])
      lista.push(["Comprar carne en la carnicería.", s[5]])
      lista.push(["Darle la carne a madre.", s[6]])
      lista.push(["Leer los anuncios del portal.", s[7]])
      if s[3] and s[4] and s[6] and s[7]
        lista.push(["Volver con madre.", false])
      end
    else
      lista.push(["Ir a ver qué quiere madre.", false])
    end
    return lista
  end
  # Acto II: segun turno (variable 7) y fase (variable 8)
  def self.tareas_acto2
    s = $game_switches
    t = $game_variables[7]
    f = $game_variables[8]
    lista = []
    if s[27]
      lista.push(["Volver a casa: el 3ºB.", false]) if $game_map.map_id == 3 and !s[28]
      lista.push(["Darle el sueldo a madre.", s[28]])
      lista.push(["Acostarte. Mañana hay turno.", false]) if s[28]
      return lista
    end
    lista.push(["Fichar a la entrada.", s[24]])
    lista.push(["Ponerte el mono en el vestuario.", s[25]]) if s[24]
    return lista unless s[25]
    case t
    when 1
      lista.push(["La cadena: el puesto de la cinta.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Traer la manguera del pasillo de mantenimiento.", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["Devolverle la manguera a Cripps.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
    when 2
      lista.push(["La cadena: el puesto de corte.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Llevar piezas a las cámaras (" + $game_variables[13].to_s + "/3).", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["La rejilla del pasillo de mantenimiento.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
      lista.push(["El libro de Cripps, en su oficina.", f > 6]) if f >= 6
      lista.push(["Volver a la rejilla.", f > 7]) if f >= 7
    when 3
      lista.push(["Hablar con Cripps en la cadena.", f > 3])
      lista.push(["Traer la vaca del corral del fondo.", f > 4]) if f >= 4
      lista.push(["El cajón.", f > 5]) if f >= 5
    end
    lista.push(["Fichar la salida.", false]) if f >= 9
    return lista
  end
end

class Window_Tareas < Window_Base

    super(200, 64, 420, 288)

    refresh

    self.contents.clear
    self.contents.font.color = system_color
    self.contents.draw_text(4, 0, 380, 32, "Pendiente")

        self.contents.font.color = disabled_color

      else

        marca = "- "

      y += 30
    end

class Scene_Menu
  def initialize(menu_index = 0)

  def main
    @spriteset = Spriteset_Map.new
    @command_window = Window_Command.new(160, ["Objetos", "Guardar", "Salir"])
    @command_window.x = 20
    @command_window.y = 64

    2 => ["Fin del Acto II", "La cadena", "Acto III: Lucy", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],

#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Matadero (Acto II)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Minijuegos de trabajo (el corte y la cinta), vigilancia de Cripps y
#  escondites. Se llaman desde eventos con "Llamar script":
#    minijuego_corte(rondas)   -> resultado en la variable 12 (aciertos)
#    minijuego_cinta(piezas)   -> resultado en la variable 12 (aciertos)
#  Compatible con RGSS1 (Ruby 1.8).
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base comun: capa oscura encima del mapa, textos y espera
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Minijuego
  def initialize
    @vp = Viewport.new(0, 0, 640, 480)
    @vp.z = 6000
    @sprites = []
    @fondo = nuevo_sprite(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(6, 4, 4, 200))
  end
  def nuevo_sprite(w, h)
    s = Sprite.new(@vp)
    s.bitmap = Bitmap.new(w, h)
    @sprites.push(s)
    return s
  end
  def texto(s, y, tam, color, h = 32)
    sp = nuevo_sprite(640, h)
    sp.y = y
    sp.bitmap.font.size = tam
    sp.bitmap.font.color = color
    sp.bitmap.draw_text(0, 0, 640, h, s, 1)
    return sp
  end
  def rotulo(sp, s, color)
    sp.bitmap.clear
    sp.bitmap.font.color = color
    sp.bitmap.draw_text(0, 0, 640, sp.bitmap.height, s, 1)
  end
  def esperar(n)
    n.times do
      tick
    end
  end
  def tick
    Graphics.update
    Input.update
    @vp.update
  end
  def se(nombre, vol = 80, tono = 100)
    $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new(nombre, vol, tono))
  end
  def veneno
    return Vacas.veneno
  end
  def dispose
    for s in @sprites
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    @vp.dispose
  end
  CLARO = Color.new(214, 204, 186)
  GRIS  = Color.new(140, 130, 118)
  ROJO  = Color.new(190, 36, 30)
  OSCURO = Color.new(60, 10, 10)
end

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# El corte: una cuchilla va y viene por una barra. Hay que soltarla
# (Intro) cuando cruza la franja roja. La franja se estrecha.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Corte < Vacas_Minijuego
  BX = 120
  BW = 400
  BY = 330
  def initialize(rondas)
    super()
    @rondas = rondas
    texto("EL CORTE", 26, 26, ROJO, 36)
    texto("Pulsa Intro cuando la cuchilla cruce la franja roja.", 62, 18, GRIS)
    @canal = nuevo_sprite(160, 220)
    @canal.x = 240
    @canal.y = 92
    dibujar_canal(0)
    @barra = nuevo_sprite(BW + 8, 32)
    @barra.x = BX - 4
    @barra.y = BY
    @cuchilla = nuevo_sprite(6, 44)
    @cuchilla.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 6, 44, Color.new(230, 232, 236))
    @cuchilla.bitmap.fill_rect(2, 0, 2, 44, Color.new(120, 124, 130))
    @cuchilla.y = BY - 6
    @info = texto("", 380, 22, CLARO)
    @cuenta = texto("", 420, 18, GRIS)
  end
  def dibujar_canal(cortes)
    b = @canal.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(76, 0, 8, 20, Color.new(150, 156, 162))
    b.fill_rect(30, 20, 100, 190, Color.new(30, 6, 6))
    b.fill_rect(34, 24, 92, 182, Color.new(140, 48, 44))
    b.fill_rect(46, 30, 68, 170, Color.new(168, 74, 64))
    y = 40
    while y < 196
      b.fill_rect(48, y, 64, 3, Color.new(214, 196, 170))
      y += 14
    end
    b.fill_rect(78, 24, 4, 182, Color.new(96, 26, 24))
    for i in 0...cortes
      yy = 40 + i * 26
      b.fill_rect(20, yy, 120, 2, Color.new(20, 0, 0))
    end
  end
  def nueva_franja(r)
    ancho = 70 - r * 6
    ancho = 38 if ancho < 38
    @zona_w = ancho
    @zona_x = 20 + rand(BW - ancho - 40)
    b = @barra.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, BW + 8, 32, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    b.fill_rect(4, 4, BW, 24, Color.new(70, 66, 62))
    b.fill_rect(4 + @zona_x, 4, @zona_w, 24, Color.new(150, 24, 20))
    b.fill_rect(4 + @zona_x + @zona_w / 2 - 1, 4, 2, 24, Color.new(220, 120, 110))
  end
  def run
    aciertos = 0
    esperar(30)
    for r in 0...@rondas
      nueva_franja(r)
      rotulo(@cuenta, "Pieza " + (r + 1).to_s + " de " + @rondas.to_s, GRIS)
      rotulo(@info, "", CLARO)
      pos = 0.0
      vel = [4.0 + r * 0.6, 7.0].min
      dir = 1
      marco = 0
      soltado = false
      while marco < 360
        tick
        marco += 1
        pos += vel * dir
        if pos >= BW - 2
          pos = BW - 2
          dir = -1
        elsif pos <= 0
          pos = 0
          dir = 1
        end
        temblor = 0
        temblor = rand(5) - 2 if veneno >= 50 and rand(6) == 0
        @cuchilla.x = BX + pos.to_i - 3 + temblor
        # alucinacion: la canal respira
        if veneno >= 40 and marco % 90 < 10
          @canal.zoom_x = 1.0 + (marco % 90) * 0.004
        else
          @canal.zoom_x = 1.0
        end
        if Input.trigger?(Input::C)
          soltado = true
          break
        end
      end
      centro = pos - @zona_x
      if soltado and centro >= 0 and centro <= @zona_w
        aciertos += 1
        se("093-Attack05", 80, 70)
        @vp.flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 90), 6)
        rotulo(@info, "Limpio.", CLARO)
      else
        se("057-Wrong01", 70, 80)
        @vp.flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 200), 10)
        rotulo(@info, soltado ? "Torcido. Se ha astillado el hueso." : "Demasiado lento.", ROJO)
      end
      dibujar_canal(aciertos)
      esperar(40)
    end
    rotulo(@cuenta, "", GRIS)
    rotulo(@info, "Cortes limpios: " + aciertos.to_s + " de " + @rondas.to_s, CLARO)
    esperar(70)
    return aciertos
  end
end

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# La cinta: piezas que llegan por la derecha con una flecha. Pulsa esa
# direccion cuando la pieza esta dentro del recuadro. La cinta acelera.
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Vacas_Cinta < Vacas_Minijuego
  ZX = 90
  ZW = 70
  CY = 250
  DIRS = [2, 4, 6, 8]
  def initialize(piezas)
    super()
    @total = piezas
    texto("LA CINTA", 26, 26, ROJO, 36)
    texto("Pulsa la flecha de cada pieza cuando entre en el recuadro.", 62, 18, GRIS)
    @cinta = nuevo_sprite(640, 80)
    @cinta.y = CY - 10
    @cinta_off = 0
    @zona = nuevo_sprite(ZW, 76)
    @zona.x = ZX
    @zona.y = CY - 8
    pintar_zona(Color.new(200, 190, 170))
    @info = texto("", 360, 22, CLARO)
    @cuenta = texto("", 400, 18, GRIS)
    @piezas = []
  end
  def pintar_zona(c)
    b = @zona.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, ZW, 3, c)
    b.fill_rect(0, 73, ZW, 3, c)
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, 3, 76, c)
    b.fill_rect(ZW - 3, 0, 3, 76, c)
  end
  def pintar_cinta
    b = @cinta.bitmap
    b.clear
    b.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 60, Color.new(20, 20, 22))
    b.fill_rect(0, 4, 640, 52, Color.new(52, 52, 54))
    x = -(@cinta_off % 24)
    while x < 640
      b.fill_rect(x, 4, 2, 52, Color.new(82, 82, 84))
      x += 24
    end
  end
  def flecha(b, d, cx, cy, c)
    for i in 0...10
      case d
      when 8 then b.fill_rect(cx - i, cy - 8 + i, i * 2 + 1, 1, c)
      when 2 then b.fill_rect(cx - i, cy + 8 - i, i * 2 + 1, 1, c)
      when 4 then b.fill_rect(cx - 8 + i, cy - i, 1, i * 2 + 1, c)
      when 6 then b.fill_rect(cx + 8 - i, cy - i, 1, i * 2 + 1, c)
      end
    end
  end
  def nueva_pieza
    s = nuevo_sprite(48, 48)
    d = DIRS[rand(4)]
    b = s.bitmap
    b.fill_rect(2, 6, 44, 36, Color.new(30, 6, 6))
    b.fill_rect(4, 8, 40, 32, Color.new(150, 52, 46))
    b.fill_rect(6, 12, 36, 4, Color.new(214, 196, 170))
    flecha(b, d, 24, 26, Color.new(240, 236, 226))
    s.x = 640
    s.y = CY
    @piezas.push([s, d, false])
  end
  def run
    aciertos = 0
    lanzadas = 0
    espera = 0
    vel = 3.0
    esperar(30)
    loop do
      tick
      @cinta_off += vel.to_i
      pintar_cinta
      espera -= 1
      if lanzadas < @total and espera <= 0
        nueva_pieza
        lanzadas += 1
        espera = 70 - lanzadas * 3
        espera = 34 if espera < 34
        vel += 0.25
      end
      pulsada = Input.dir4
      pulsada = 0 unless Input.trigger?(Input::DOWN) or Input.trigger?(Input::LEFT) or
                         Input.trigger?(Input::RIGHT) or Input.trigger?(Input::UP)
      # pieza mas adelantada todavia viva
      primera = nil
      for p in @piezas
        next if p[2]
        primera = p
        break
      end
      if pulsada != 0 and primera != nil
        dentro = primera[0].x + 24 >= ZX and primera[0].x + 24 <= ZX + ZW
        if dentro and pulsada == primera[1]
          aciertos += 1
          primera[2] = true
          primera[0].visible = false
          se("093-Attack05", 70, 90)
          pintar_zona(Color.new(220, 60, 50))
          rotulo(@info, "Bien.", CLARO)
        else
          se("057-Wrong01", 60, 80)
          @vp.flash(Color.new(120, 0, 0, 80), 6)
          primera[2] = true
          primera[0].opacity = 90
          rotulo(@info, "¡Esa no!", ROJO)
        end
      end
      for p in @piezas
        p[0].x -= vel.to_i
        if !p[2] and p[0].x + 24 < ZX
          p[2] = true
          p[0].opacity = 90
          se("057-Wrong01", 50, 70)
          rotulo(@info, "Se te ha escapado una.", ROJO)
        end
        if p[0].x < -48 and p[0].visible
          p[0].visible = false
        end
      end
      pintar_zona(Color.new(200, 190, 170)) if Graphics.frame_count % 12 == 0
      if veneno >= 45 and rand(240) == 0
        @vp.flash(Color.new(0, 0, 0, 160), 8)
      end
      rotulo(@cuenta, "Piezas: " + aciertos.to_s + " / " + @total.to_s, GRIS) if Graphics.frame_count % 10 == 0
      terminado = (lanzadas >= @total)
      for p in @piezas
        terminado = false if p[0].x > -48 and p[0].visible
      end
      break if terminado
    end
    rotulo(@info, "La cinta se para. Piezas a tiempo: " + aciertos.to_s + " de " + @total.to_s, CLARO)
    esperar(70)
    return aciertos
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Vigilancia de Cripps
#   Los eventos llamados "Cripps vigila" ven en linea recta hacia donde
#   miran (5 casillas) y notan al jugador pegado a ellos. Las paredes y las
#   canales colgadas tapan la vista. Escondido, no te ven.
#==============================================================================
class Game_Event
  def vacas_vigia?
    return false if @erased or @character_name == "" or @transparent or @opacity == 0
    return @event.name == "Cripps vigila"
  end
  def vacas_tapa?(x, y)
    for ev in $game_map.events.values
      next if ev == self or ev.through
      next if ev.character_name == ""
      return true if ev.x == x and ev.y == y
    end
    return false
  end
  def vacas_ve_al_jugador?
    px = $game_player.x
    py = $game_player.y
    dx = px - @x
    dy = py - @y
    return true if dx.abs + dy.abs <= 1
    rango = 5
    case @direction
    when 2 then return false unless dx == 0 and dy > 0 and dy <= rango
    when 8 then return false unless dx == 0 and dy < 0 and -dy <= rango
    when 6 then return false unless dy == 0 and dx > 0 and dx <= rango
    when 4 then return false unless dy == 0 and dx < 0 and -dx <= rango
    else return false
    end
    sx = (dx <=> 0)
    sy = (dy <=> 0)
    x = @x + sx
    y = @y + sy
    while x != px or y != py
      return false unless $game_map.passable?(x, y, 0)
      return false if vacas_tapa?(x, y)
      x += sx
      y += sy
    end
    return true
  end
end

class Game_Map
  alias vacas_gm_update update
  def update
    vacas_gm_update
    vacas_vigilar
  end
  def vacas_vigilar
    return unless $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_CAM] or $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PATRULLA_OFI]
    return if $game_switches[Vacas::SW_ESCONDIDO2] or $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS]
    return if $game_system.map_interpreter.running? or $game_temp.message_window_showing
    for ev in @events.values
      next unless ev.vacas_vigia?
      if ev.vacas_ve_al_jugador?
        $game_switches[Vacas::SW_PILLADO_CRIPPS] = true
        @need_refresh = true
        $game_screen.start_flash(Color.new(255, 0, 0, 160), 10)
        $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("092-Attack04", 90, 60))
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

module Vacas
  def self.preparar_mente(completo = false)
    for a in $game_party.actors
      # Tambien migra partidas anteriores sin reiniciar sus estadisticas.
      for id in [61, 62, 63, 64]
        a.learn_skill(id)
      end
      a.set_graphic(a.character_name, a.character_hue, 'steven_mente', 0)
      if completo
        a.recover_all
      else
        a.hp = [a.hp, a.maxhp * 3 / 4].max
        a.sp = [a.sp, a.maxsp * 3 / 4].max
      end
    end
  end
end

class Scene_Map

  def call_battle
    # Los encuentros aleatorios se limitan a estos mapas y fuera de patrullas.
    if $game_temp.battle_proc == nil
      unless Vacas.veneno >= 35 and [8, 9, 11].include?($game_map.map_id) and
          !$game_switches[26] and !$game_switches[29] and !$game_switches[30]
        $game_temp.battle_calling = false

    end
    Vacas.preparar_mente(false)
    $vacas_tone_antes = $game_screen.tone.clone
    $vacas_fondo_antes = $game_map.battleback_name
    troop = $game_temp.battle_troop_id
    fondo = [2, 8].include?(troop) ? 'piso' : ([3, 6, 14, 15, 16, 17].include?(troop) ? 'tunel' : 'matadero')
    $game_map.battleback_name = 'mente_' + fondo

  end

class Game_Battler
  alias vacas_mente_skill_effect skill_effect
  def skill_effect(user, skill)
    effective = vacas_mente_skill_effect(user, skill)
    if $game_temp.in_battle and self.is_a?(Game_Actor)
      if user.is_a?(Game_Enemy) and effective
        extra = {65=>4, 66=>5, 67=>6, 68=>4, 69=>3, 70=>7}[skill.id]
        Vacas.veneno = [96, Vacas.veneno + extra].min if extra != nil
      elsif skill.id == 61
        self.sp += 18
        for id in [2, 3, 4]
          remove_state(id)
        end
        Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno - 6
        effective = true
      end
    end
    return effective
  end

class Scene_Battle
  alias vacas_mente_start_phase2 start_phase2

    # Solo un pequeño aumento por ronda, sin alcanzar el game over de historia.

    $game_variables[18] = result

    $game_player.make_encounter_count

    unless $vacas_tone_antes.nil?

# Mascara con radio cercano y cono orientado; no ocupa Pictures 98 ni toca tono.
# Solo cinco bitmaps compartidos por spriteset, se liberan al transferir.
class Sprite_Linterna < Sprite
  def initialize(viewport = nil)
    super(viewport)
    self.z=2900
    @mascaras={}
    @direccion=nil
  end
  def mascara(d)
    return @mascaras[d] if @mascaras[d]
    b=Bitmap.new(1280,960)
    b.fill_rect(0,0,1280,960,Color.new(1,8,7,218))
    # Crear agujero por franjas horizontales; no hay get_pixel por fotograma.
    for y in -190..190
      (-190).step(190,4) do |x|
        dist=Math.sqrt(x*x+y*y)
        near=d==0 ? 35 : 57
        forward = d==2 ? y : d==8 ? -y : d==6 ? x : -x
        cross = (d==2 || d==8) ? x.abs : y.abs
        beam=d!=0 && forward>0 && forward<182 && cross<forward*0.52+12
        next unless dist<near || beam
        edge=dist<near ? dist/near : [forward/182.0,cross/(forward*0.52+12)].max
        a=[0,((edge-0.45)*330).to_i].max
        a=[218,a].min
        b.fill_rect(640+x,480+y,4,1,Color.new(1,8,7,a))
      end
    end
    @mascaras[d]=b
    return b
  end
  def update
    super
    on=Vacas.bajo_ciudad? && ![20,21].include?($game_map.map_id)
    self.visible=on
    return unless on
    d=$game_switches[115] && $game_variables[52]>0 ? $game_player.direction : 0
    if @direccion!=d
      self.bitmap=mascara(d)
      @direccion=d
    end
    self.x=$game_player.screen_x-640
    self.y=$game_player.screen_y-18-480
  end
  def dispose
    for b in @mascaras.values
      b.dispose
    end
    super
  end
end
class Sprite_Bateria < Sprite
  def initialize
    super(nil)
    self.bitmap=Bitmap.new(330,42)

# Vacas: interfaz completa. RGSS1 / Ruby 1.8. Instalar despues de BajoCiudad.
module Vacas_Config
  FILE = 'Vacas.cfg'
  DEFAULTS = {:bgm=>80, :bgs=>70, :se=>80, :me=>80, :texto=>2,
    :brillo=>100, :intensidad=>70, :subtitulos=>true}
  def self.values
    return @values if @values
    @values = DEFAULTS.clone
    begin
      data = File.open(FILE, 'rb') { |f| Marshal.load(f) }
      DEFAULTS.each do |k,v|
        n = data[k] if data.is_a?(Hash)
        if v == true
          @values[k] = n if n == true || n == false
        elsif n.is_a?(Numeric)
          limits = k == :texto ? [1,4] : (k == :brillo ? [50,150] : [0,100])
          @values[k] = [[n.to_i,limits[0]].max,limits[1]].min
        end
      end
    rescue StandardError
      # Config ausente/corrupta: valores seguros, no afecta a las partidas.
    end
    @values
  end
  def self.get(k); values[k]; end
  def self.set(k,v); values[k]=v; end
  def self.save
    begin
      File.open(FILE+'.tmp','wb') { |f| Marshal.dump(values,f) }
      File.delete(FILE+'.bak') if FileTest.exist?(FILE+'.bak')
      File.rename(FILE,FILE+'.bak') if FileTest.exist?(FILE)
      File.rename(FILE+'.tmp',FILE)
      true
    rescue StandardError
      File.rename(FILE+'.bak',FILE) if !FileTest.exist?(FILE) && FileTest.exist?(FILE+'.bak')
      false
    end
  end
end

module Audio
  class << self
    def vacas_tracks; @vacas_tracks ||= {}; end
    alias vacas_original_bgm_play bgm_play
    alias vacas_original_bgs_play bgs_play
    alias vacas_original_se_play se_play
    alias vacas_original_me_play me_play
    def vacas_dispatch(kind,original,args)
        name=args[0]; volume=args[1] || 100; pitch=args[2] || 100
        base=File.basename(name.to_s).sub(/\.[^.]+$/, '')
        key=Vacas_Audio::LEGACY[base]
        key=Vacas_Audio.screamer if base=='092-Attack04' && Vacas_Audio.screamer
        if [:llave_recoger,:papel_nota,:recoger_objeto,:frasco_de_vidrio].include?(key)
          return unless Vacas_Audio.allow_pickup?
        end
        if key && kind==:bgs && $game_map && Vacas_Audio::MAP_AUDIO[$game_map.map_id]
          key=Vacas_Audio::MAP_AUDIO[$game_map.map_id][2]
        end
        if key
          row=Vacas_Audio::TABLE[key]
          name='Audio/'+kind.to_s.upcase+'/'+row[1]
          volume=[volume,row[2]].min; pitch=row[3]
        end
        vacas_tracks[kind]=[name,volume,pitch] if [:bgm,:bgs].include?(kind)
        if key==:susto || base==Vacas_Audio::TABLE[:susto][1] || base.index('se_screamer_')==0 || key.to_s.index('screamer_')==0
          volume=volume*Vacas_Config.get(:intensidad)/100
        end
        if Vacas_Audio.path?(name.to_s)
          Vacas_Audio.subtitle(row[4]) if key
          send(original,name,volume*Vacas_Config.get(kind)/100,pitch)
        elsif [:bgm,:bgs].include?(kind)
          send(kind.to_s+'_stop')
        end
    end
    def bgm_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:bgm,:vacas_original_bgm_play,args); end
    def bgs_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:bgs,:vacas_original_bgs_play,args); end
    def se_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:se,:vacas_original_se_play,args); end
    def me_play(*args); vacas_dispatch(:me,:vacas_original_me_play,args); end
    alias vacas_original_bgm_stop bgm_stop
    alias vacas_original_bgs_stop bgs_stop
    def bgm_stop; vacas_tracks.delete(:bgm); vacas_original_bgm_stop; end
    def bgs_stop; vacas_tracks.delete(:bgs); vacas_original_bgs_stop; end
  end
end

module Vacas_UI

    b.draw_text(x,y,w,[size+8,28].max,s.to_s,align)
  end
  def self.bar(b,x,y,w,value,max,kind)

class Scene_VacasSettings
  KEYS=[:bgm,:bgs,:se,:me,:texto,:brillo,:intensidad,:subtitulos,:fullscreen,:volver]
  LABELS=['Musica / BGM','Ambiente / BGS','Efectos / SE','Melodias / ME',
    'Velocidad de texto','Brillo','Sustos y temblores','Subtitulos de sonido',
    'Pantalla completa','Guardar y volver']
  def initialize(origin=:menu); @origin=origin; end
  def main
    @background=Vacas_UI.background
    @panel=Window_VacasPanel.new(32,8,576,80)
    @panel.lines('AJUSTES',''.split)
    @list=Window_VacasCommand.new(32,88,576,LABELS)
    @hint=Window_VacasPanel.new(32,432,576,48)
    draw
    Vacas_UI.loop_scene(self)
    @background.dispose; @panel.dispose; @list.dispose; @hint.dispose
  end
  def draw
    @list.contents.clear
    KEYS.each_with_index do |k,i|
      value=Vacas_Config.get(k)
      s=case k
      when :subtitulos; value ? 'Si' : 'No'
      when :texto; {1=>'Rapida',2=>'Normal',3=>'Lenta',4=>'Muy lenta'}[value]
      when :fullscreen; 'Alt + Enter'
      when :volver; ''
      else; value.to_s+' %'
      end
      Vacas_UI.text(@list.contents,16,i*32,350,LABELS[i],20)
      Vacas_UI.text(@list.contents,366,i*32,170,s,20,Vacas_UI::MINT,2)
    end
    @hint.contents.clear
    Vacas_UI.text(@hint.contents,0,-5,540,'Izq / Der: ajustar    Esc: guardar y volver',15)
  end
  def update
    @background.update; @list.update
    key=KEYS[@list.index]
    delta=Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT) ? 1 : (Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT) ? -1 : 0)
    if key==:volver && Input.trigger?(Input::C) || Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      if Vacas_Config.save
        Vacas_Audio.play(:cancelar)
        $scene= @origin==:titulo ? Scene_Title.new : Scene_Menu.new(4)
      else
        @hint.lines('No se pudo escribir Vacas.cfg. Reintenta.',[])
        Vacas_Audio.play(:error)
      end
      return
    end
    if key==:subtitulos && (delta!=0 || Input.trigger?(Input::C))
      Vacas_Config.set(key,!Vacas_Config.get(key)); draw
    elsif delta!=0 && ![:fullscreen,:volver,:subtitulos].include?(key)
      low=key==:texto ? 1 : (key==:brillo ? 50 : 0)
      high=key==:texto ? 4 : (key==:brillo ? 150 : 100)
      step=key==:texto ? 1 : 5
      Vacas_Config.set(key,[[Vacas_Config.get(key)+delta*step,low].max,high].min)
      Vacas_Audio.refresh if [:bgm,:bgs,:se,:me].include?(key)
      Vacas_Audio.play(:cursor); draw
    end
  end
end

class Window_BattleStatus
  def initialize
    super(176,334,464,146)
    self.contents=Bitmap.new(432,114)
    @level_up_flags=[false,false,false,false]; @ui_values={}; refresh
  end
  def refresh
    return unless self.contents
    a=$game_party.actors[0]; return unless a
    @ui_values ||= {}
    signature=[a.hp,a.sp,Vacas.veneno,a.states.clone]
    settled=[:hp,:sp,:veneno].all? do |k|
      target=k==:veneno ? Vacas.veneno : a.send(k)
      @ui_values[k] && (@ui_values[k]-target).abs<0.2
    end
    return if @ui_signature==signature && settled
    @ui_signature=signature
    self.contents.clear
    {:hp=>a.hp,:sp=>a.sp,:veneno=>Vacas.veneno}.each do |key,value|
      @ui_values[key]=value.to_f unless @ui_values[key]
      @ui_values[key]+=(value-@ui_values[key])*0.2
    end
    b=contents
    Vacas_UI.text(b,0,0,240,a.name+' / MANTENTE AQUI',19,Vacas_UI::MINT)
    Vacas_UI.text(b,0,28,204,'Salud '+a.hp.to_s+'/'+a.maxhp.to_s,17)

# Creditos completos del pack, incluidos autores secundarios, obras y enlaces.
# Se pagina texto ya ajustado al ancho real de la fuente, incluidas URL largas.
class Scene_VacasCredits
  def main
    @background=Vacas_UI.background('titulo')
    @panel=Window_VacasPanel.new(24,64,592,350)
    @footer=Window_VacasPanel.new(24,416,592,64)
    @page=0; @lines=Vacas_Audio::CREDITS_LINES
    @pages=[(@lines.size+11)/12,1].max
    draw
    Vacas_UI.loop_scene(self)
    @panel.dispose; @footer.dispose; @background.dispose
  end
  def draw
    @panel.contents.clear
    12.times do |i|
      line=@lines[@page*12+i]
      b=@panel.contents; b.font.name='Courier New'; b.font.size=16; b.font.color=Vacas_UI::INK
      b.draw_text(4,i*25,548,25,line) if line
    end
    @footer.contents.clear
    Vacas_UI.text(@footer.contents,0,0,552,
      'Creditos '+(@page+1).to_s+'/'+@pages.to_s+'  Flechas: pagina  Esc: titulo',16)
  end
  def update
    @background.update
    if Input.trigger?(Input::B)
      Vacas_Audio.play(:cancelar); $scene=Scene_Title.new; return
    end
    delta=0
    delta=1 if Input.repeat?(Input::RIGHT) || Input.repeat?(Input::DOWN) || Input.trigger?(Input::C)
    delta=-1 if Input.repeat?(Input::LEFT) || Input.repeat?(Input::UP)
    next_page=[[@page+delta,0].max,@pages-1].min
    if next_page!=@page
      @page=next_page; Vacas_Audio.play(:cursor); draw
    end
  end
end

module Vacas_Audio
  def self.allow_pickup?
    now=Graphics.frame_count
    return false if @pickup_frame && now>=@pickup_frame && now-@pickup_frame<10
    @pickup_frame=now; true
  end
  def self.pickup(key)
    play(key) if allow_pickup?
  end
end
class Game_Party
  alias audio_gain_item gain_item
  def gain_item(id,n)
    before=item_number(id)
    audio_gain_item(id,n)
    if n>0 && item_number(id)>before && $scene.is_a?(Scene_Map)
      name=$data_items[id] ? $data_items[id].name.downcase : ''
      key=name.include?('llave') ? :llave_recoger : :recoger_objeto
      key=:papel_nota if [4,6,8,9,10,11,13,15,23,24,28,33,34].include?(id)
      key=:frasco_de_vidrio if name.include?('tarro') || name.include?('frasco')
      Vacas_Audio.pickup(key)
    end
  end
end
module Vacas
  class << self
    alias audio_actualizar_linterna actualizar_linterna
    def actualizar_linterna
      before=$game_switches[115]
      audio_actualizar_linterna
      if before!=$game_switches[115] && @audio_recharge_frame!=Graphics.frame_count
        Vacas_Audio.play(:linterna_clic)
      end
    end
    alias audio_recargar recargar
    def recargar
      result=audio_recargar
      if result
        @audio_recharge_frame=Graphics.frame_count
        Vacas_Audio.play(:linterna_clic)
      end
      result
    end
  end
end

class Vacas_Minijuego
  def se(nombre,vol=80,tono=100)
    if nombre=='093-Attack05'
      Vacas_Audio.play(is_a?(Vacas_Corte) ? :cuchilla_corte_de_carne : :gancho_metalico)
    else
      $game_system.se_play(RPG::AudioFile.new(nombre,vol,tono))
    end
  end
end

Scripts.name: Vacas_IntroFeka
Scripts.code:
# Vacas: intro animada de Feka Studios. RGSS1 / Ruby 1.8.
# Seccion Vacas_IntroFeka, despues de Vacas_Interfaz y antes de Main.
# Solo la lanza Main al arrancar el programa; despues cede el paso a la
# cadena de arranque de siempre (aviso de contenido -> titulo).
# Graficos: Graphics/Pictures/feka_*.png (herramientas/arte_intro_feka.py).
class Scene_FekaIntro
  FONDO   = Color.new(8, 7, 11)        # #08070b
  NEON    = [255, 61, 87]              # #ff3d57
  LOGO_X  = 136                        # logo 368x146 centrado en 640
  LOGO_Y  = 150
  GOTA_X  = LOGO_X + 107               # centro de la gota dentro del logo
  GOTA_Y  = LOGO_Y + 85
  SUELO_Y = 322                        # donde salpica (eje de la linea)
  # Fotogramas a 40 fps: 250 = 6,25 s.
  T_LOGO  = 20                         # enciende el neon
  T_FIJO  = 64                         # logo estable
  T_CAE   = 100                        # la gota se suelta
  T_SALPI = 126                        # toca el suelo
  T_TEXTO = 150                        # aparece PRESENTA
  T_FUERA = 222                        # fundido a negro
  T_FIN   = 250
  # Opacidad del tubo de neon al encender (un valor cada 2 fotogramas).
  PARPADEO = [170, 40, 215, 0, 0, 0, 255, 95, 255, 255, 255, 130, 255, 255,
              70, 255, 255, 255, 190, 255, 255, 255]
  SE_NEON   = ['Audio/SE/se_interruptor_luz', 80, 100]
  SE_SALPI  = ['Audio/SE/se_chapoteo_1', 70, 110]

  def self.siguiente
    defined?(Scene_Aviso) ? Scene_Aviso.new : Scene_Title.new
  end

  def main
    begin
      crear
    rescue StandardError, Errno::ENOENT
      # Falta algun grafico: la intro se omite, el juego arranca igual.
      liberar
      $scene = Scene_FekaIntro.siguiente
      return
    end
    @t = 0
    @salida = nil
    @intensidad = Vacas_Config.get(:intensidad)
    Graphics.transition(2)
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      update
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    liberar
  end

  def sprite(nombre, x, y, z)
    s = Sprite.new
    @sprites.push(s)
    @propios.push(s) unless nombre
    s.bitmap = nombre ? RPG::Cache.picture(nombre) : Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    s.x = x; s.y = y; s.z = z; s.opacity = 0
    s
  end

  def crear
    @sprites = []; @propios = []; @gotas = []
    @fondo = sprite(nil, 0, 0, 0)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, FONDO); @fondo.opacity = 255
    @halo = sprite('feka_halo', 64, 95, 1); @halo.blend_type = 1
    @fantasma = sprite('feka_logo', LOGO_X, LOGO_Y, 2)
    @fantasma.blend_type = 1
    @fantasma.color = Color.new(NEON[0], NEON[1], NEON[2], 255)
    @logo = sprite('feka_logo', LOGO_X, LOGO_Y, 3)
    @franjas = [sprite('feka_logo', LOGO_X, LOGO_Y, 4),
                sprite('feka_logo', LOGO_X, LOGO_Y, 4)]
    @linea = sprite('feka_linea', LOGO_X, SUELO_Y - 6, 3)
    @texto = sprite('feka_presenta', 0, 344, 3)
    @texto.x = (640 - @texto.bitmap.width) / 2
    @destello = sprite('feka_halo', GOTA_X, SUELO_Y, 4)
    @destello.blend_type = 1; @destello.ox = 256; @destello.oy = 128
    @destello.zoom_x = 0.3; @destello.zoom_y = 0.3
    @gota = sprite('feka_gota', GOTA_X, GOTA_Y, 5)
    @gota.ox = 8; @gota.oy = 8
    9.times do |i|
      g = sprite('feka_gota', GOTA_X, SUELO_Y, 5)
      g.ox = 8; g.oy = 8
      g.color = Color.new(NEON[0], NEON[1], NEON[2], 255)
      z = 0.28 + rand(30) / 100.0
      g.zoom_x = z; g.zoom_y = z
      vx = (i - 4) * 0.75 + (rand(9) - 4) / 10.0
      @gotas.push([g, GOTA_X.to_f, SUELO_Y.to_f, vx, -2.2 - rand(30) / 10.0])
    end
    @velo = sprite(nil, 0, 0, 20)
    @velo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0)); @velo.opacity = 255
  end

  def liberar
    return unless @sprites
    @sprites.each do |s|
      next if s.disposed?
      s.bitmap.dispose if @propios.include?(s) && s.bitmap && !s.bitmap.disposed?
      s.dispose
    end
    @sprites = nil
  end

  def se(datos)
    Audio.se_play(datos[0], datos[1], datos[2])   # pasa por los ajustes de volumen
  end

  def rampa(desde, hasta)
    return 0.0 if @t <= desde
    return 1.0 if @t >= hasta
    (@t - desde).to_f / (hasta - desde)
  end

  def update
    @t += 1
    if @salida.nil? && (Input.trigger?(Input::C) || Input.trigger?(Input::B))
      @salida = [@t, 10]                      # saltar: fundido rapido
      Audio.se_stop
    end
    @salida = [@t, T_FIN - T_FUERA] if @salida.nil? && @t >= T_FUERA
    se(SE_NEON) if @t == T_LOGO && @salida.nil?
    se(SE_SALPI) if @t == T_SALPI && @salida.nil?
    update_logo
    update_gota
    update_salpicadura
    # Velo negro: entrada, salida y salto.
    if @salida
      k = (@t - @salida[0]).to_f / @salida[1]
      @velo.opacity = [255 * k, 255].min
      $scene = Scene_FekaIntro.siguiente if k >= 1.0
    else
      @velo.opacity = 255 * (1.0 - rampa(0, 18))
    end
  end

  def update_logo
    f = @t - T_LOGO
    if f < 0
      nivel = 0
    elsif f < PARPADEO.size * 2 && @intensidad > 0
      crudo = PARPADEO[f / 2]
      nivel = 255 - (255 - crudo) * [@intensidad + 30, 100].min / 100
      nivel = nivel * [f / 10.0, 1.0].min if @intensidad < 30
    else
      nivel = 255 * [f / 24.0, 1.0].min
    end
    @logo.opacity = nivel
    # Aberracion roja: fuerte al encender, residual despues.
    vivo = (@t >= T_LOGO && @t < T_FIJO && @intensidad > 0)
    @fantasma.x = LOGO_X + (vivo ? (rand(2) == 0 ? -3 : 3) : 1)
    @fantasma.y = LOGO_Y + (vivo ? 0 : 1)
    @fantasma.opacity = vivo ? nivel * 0.55 : nivel * 0.22
    # Franjas desplazadas (glitch) solo mientras enciende.
    @franjas.each do |s|
      if vivo && rand(5) == 0
        alto = 6 + rand(22)
        y = rand(146 - alto)
        s.src_rect.set(0, y, 368, alto)
        s.y = LOGO_Y + y
        s.x = LOGO_X + (rand(2) == 0 ? -1 : 1) * (4 + rand(9))
        s.opacity = [nivel, 200].min
      elsif !vivo || rand(3) == 0
        s.opacity = 0
      end
    end
    # Halo: respira con el tubo y da un golpe con la salpicadura.
    base = nivel * 0.42 + Math.sin(@t / 14.0) * 14
    golpe = @t >= T_SALPI ? 110 * (1.0 - rampa(T_SALPI, T_SALPI + 34)) : 0
    @halo.opacity = [[base + golpe, 0].max, 255].min
  end

  def update_gota
    if @t < T_CAE
      @gota.opacity = @logo.opacity
      # La gota engorda y se estira antes de soltarse.
      k = rampa(T_FIJO + 10, T_CAE)
      @gota.zoom_y = 1.0 + 0.22 * k
      @gota.y = GOTA_Y + (2 * k).to_i
      @gota.color = Color.new(NEON[0], NEON[1], NEON[2], 120 * k)
    elsif @t < T_SALPI
      k = rampa(T_CAE, T_SALPI)
      @gota.opacity = 255
      @gota.y = GOTA_Y + 2 + ((SUELO_Y - GOTA_Y - 2) * k * k).to_i
      @gota.zoom_y = 1.22 + 0.7 * k
      @gota.zoom_x = 1.0 - 0.2 * k
      @gota.color = Color.new(NEON[0], NEON[1], NEON[2], 120 + 135 * k)
    else
      @gota.opacity = 0
    end
  end

  def update_salpicadura
    return if @t < T_SALPI
    vida = @t - T_SALPI
    @gotas.each do |d|
      g = d[0]
      d[1] += d[3]; d[2] += d[4]; d[4] += 0.32
      g.x = d[1].to_i; g.y = d[2].to_i
      g.opacity = d[2] > SUELO_Y + 4 ? 0 : [255 - vida * 9, 0].max
    end
    @destello.opacity = [230 - vida * 11, 0].max
    @destello.zoom_x = 0.3 + vida * 0.02
    # La linea de neon nace en el punto de impacto y corre a los dos lados.
    k = rampa(T_SALPI, T_SALPI + 30)
    k = 1.0 - (1.0 - k) * (1.0 - k)
    izq = (107 * k).to_i; der = (261 * k).to_i
    @linea.src_rect.set(107 - izq, 0, izq + der, 13)
    @linea.x = LOGO_X + 107 - izq
    @linea.opacity = [vida * 40, 255].min
    # PRESENTA sube un poco mientras aparece.
    k = rampa(T_TEXTO, T_TEXTO + 34)
    @texto.opacity = 205 * k
    @texto.y = 344 - (4 * k).to_i
  end
end

Scripts.name: Vacas_Matanza
Scripts.code:
# Acto V: La matanza. RGSS1 / Ruby 1.8.
#   Mapas 22-27, interruptores 140-171, variables 57-61, objetos 35-38,
#   enemigos/tropas 18-21, sustos 12/13. Atajo: Q + Nueva partida (W: venganza).
module Vacas
  def self.matanza?
    return $game_switches[140] && (22..27).include?($game_map.map_id)
  end
  def self.empezar_acto5
    return unless $game_switches[132]
    unless $game_switches[140]
      $game_switches[140] = true
      $game_variables[57] = 0
      $game_variables[58] = $game_switches[134] ? 1 : 0
      $game_variables[59] = $game_switches[133] ? 1 : 0
      $game_variables[60] = 0
      $game_variables[61] = 1
    end
    detener_caza
    for id in [26,29,30,31,142,150]
      $game_switches[id] = false
    end
    $game_system.timer_working = false
    $game_system.menu_disabled = false
    $game_system.save_disabled = true
    $game_player.transparent = false
    $game_temp.player_new_map_id = 22
    $game_temp.player_new_x = 3
    $game_temp.player_new_y = 11
    $game_temp.player_new_direction = 8
    $game_temp.player_transferring = true
    $game_temp.transition_processing = false
  end
  def self.prueba_acto5(venganza = false)
    prueba_acto4(false)
    for id in [114,116,117,118,119,121,124,126,127,128,129,130,131,132,135,138,139]
      $game_switches[id] = true
    end
    $game_switches[133] = !venganza
    $game_switches[134] = venganza
    $game_variables[51] = venganza ? 0 : 3
    $game_variables[54] = 2
    $game_variables[55] = 6
    $game_party.gain_item(33,1)
    empezar_acto5
    $game_temp.player_transferring = false
    $game_map.setup(22)
    $game_player.moveto(3,11)
    $game_player.turn_up
    $game_map.autoplay
    $game_map.update
  end
  def self.alarma(n)
    $game_variables[57] = [[0,$game_variables[57]+n].max,3].min
  end
  def self.inclinar(var, n)
    $game_variables[var] = [[0,$game_variables[var]+n].max,6].min
  end
  class << self
    alias matanza_tareas_antes tareas
    def tareas
      return matanza_tareas_antes unless $game_switches[140]
      s = $game_switches
      return [["Acto VI: abajo te esperan.",false]] if s[163]
      return [["Patio: hablar con la Guernsey. Amanece.",false]] if s[159]
      return [["Oficina alta: Cripps.",false]] if s[151]
      return [["Sangrado: cruzar hasta la escalera.",false]] if s[148]
      return [["Sala de matanza: invertir la noria.",false]] if $game_map.map_id >= 24
      return [["Corrales: cadenas y sirena. Luego, la nave.",false]] if $game_party.item_number(35) > 0
      return [["Muelle: las llaves estan en la garita.",false]]
    end
  end
end

module Vacas_Audio

  class << self

      return matanza_chasing

class Scene_Title
  alias matanza_nueva_partida command_new_game
  def command_new_game
    salto = Input.press?(Input::L)
    venganza = Input.press?(Input::R)
    matanza_nueva_partida
    Vacas.prueba_acto5(venganza) if salto
  end
end

# La noria: variacion dura de la cinta. Las piezas azules piden la flecha contraria.
class Vacas_Noria < Vacas_Cinta
  OPUESTA = {2=>8, 8=>2, 4=>6, 6=>4}
  def initialize(piezas)
    super(piezas)
    rotulo(@sprites[1], "LA NORIA", ROJO)
    rotulo(@sprites[2], "Roja: pulsa su flecha.  AZUL: pulsa la CONTRARIA.", GRIS)
  end
  def nueva_pieza
    s = nuevo_sprite(48, 48)

# Vigilantes del Acto V: eventos llamados "Vigia A5". Ven cinco casillas en linea recta.
class Game_Event
  def matanza_vigia?
    return false if @erased || @character_name == ""
    return @event.name == "Vigia A5"
  end
  alias matanza_ev_update update
  def update
    matanza_ev_update
    return unless $game_switches[150] && @event.name == "Cripps caza"
    return if @erased || @character_name == "" || moving? || jumping?
    return if $game_system.map_interpreter.running? || $game_temp.message_window_showing
    d = matanza_ruta
    case d
    when 2 then move_down
    when 4 then move_left
    when 6 then move_right
    when 8 then move_up
    end
  end
  # Busqueda en anchura desde el jugador: Cripps conoce su camara.
  def matanza_ruta
    w = $game_map.width
    h = $game_map.height
    px = $game_player.x
    py = $game_player.y
    dist = {}
    dist[px + py * w] = 0
    cola = [[px, py]]
    i = 0
    while i < cola.size
      x = cola[i][0]
      y = cola[i][1]
      i += 1
      d0 = dist[x + y * w]
      for paso in [[0,1],[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1]]
        nx = x + paso[0]
        ny = y + paso[1]
        next if nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h
        next if dist[nx + ny * w]
        next unless $game_map.passable?(nx, ny, 0)
        dist[nx + ny * w] = d0 + 1
        cola.push([nx, ny])
      end
    end
    mejor = 0
    valor = 9999
    for paso in [[2,0,1],[4,-1,0],[6,1,0],[8,0,-1]]
      v = dist[(@x + paso[1]) + (@y + paso[2]) * w]
      next unless v
      if v < valor
        valor = v
        mejor = paso[0]
      end
    end
    return mejor
  end
end
